name: Datacircle API
description:
Datacircle is a B2B data API with no markup. It puts B2B data providers behind one API key and one balance: you send the provider's own request to api.datacircle.dev, and you pay exactly what that provider charges for the call, nothing added. Today: LinkedIn profiles through Up2Data (a profile that isn't found is free) and HarvestAPI. Prices: [docs.datacircle.dev/pricing](https://docs.datacircle.dev/pricing).

It's a co-op. Every LinkedIn profile anyone fetches through Datacircle goes into a shared dataset, so every dollar spent grows the data for everyone. Workspaces that add $50 in funds, or invite 3 people who sign up, unlock the co-op files, new every day.

Free to start: sign up with a work email at [datacircle.dev](https://datacircle.dev) for a $5 credit, and download the 10M+ U.S. B2B leads dataset as one file: no API calls, no pagination, no rate limits.

The docs: [docs.datacircle.dev](https://docs.datacircle.dev).
